item.description: Rolls-Royce announced a £1.5bn interim share buyback on 12 November 2026 and reaffirmed its 2026 guidance for underlying operating profit and free cash flow.

item.title: Emergency alert system test set for November 18 across Canada
item.description: Alert Ready will test Canada's emergency alert system on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, on television, radio and compatible LTE or 5G wireless devices.

item.title: Arion Kurtaj pleads guilty to Rockstar hack that leaked GTA 6 footage
item.description: Arion Kurtaj, now 21, pleaded guilty at Woolwich Crown Court on November 16 to the 2022 Rockstar Games breach that leaked GTA 6.

item.title: Grammy nominations 2027 hand Raye 11 nods ahead of Feb. 7 ceremony
item.description: Raye leads the 2027 Grammy nominations with 11, Rosalía follows with nine, and the ceremony airs live on ABC from Los Angeles on February 7, 2027.

item.title: Foo Fighters tour adds two Wembley Stadium nights in September 2027
item.description: Foo Fighters will take their Take Cover tour back to the UK and Europe in 2027, with Wembley Stadium shows on September 9 and 11 and UK general sale on November 20.

item.title: Denis Villeneuve welcomes Robert Pattinson as the new James Bond
item.description: Amazon MGM Studios announced on November 16, 2026, that Robert Pattinson will play James Bond in the next 007 film, directed by Denis Villeneuve.

item.title: Quebecor proposes cash and stock offer for TELUS at a 60% premium
item.description: Quebecor has proposed to buy all TELUS shares for C$6.35 in cash plus 0.17 of a Quebecor Class B share each, a package it values at about C$19.45.

item.title: AO3 returns online with icons and imports disabled after outage
item.description: Archive of Our Own is back online after more than two weeks offline following a security incident, with icons, imports and non-HTML downloads still disabled.

item.title: New World Development Proposes $3.17 Billion Rights Issue
item.description: New World Development has proposed a rights issue that could raise about HK$24.9 billion, or US$3.17 billion, as the Hong Kong property group seeks to improve liquidity and reduce debt. item.title: Coles cyber incident probe finds no evidence of customer data loss
item.description: Coles Group is investigating a cyber security incident but says it has found no evidence so far that customer, team or supplier data was compromised or removed.

item.title: Gracie Abrams adds six Melbourne and Sydney arena shows for 2027
item.description: Gracie Abrams will play three nights each at Rod Laver Arena in Melbourne and Afterpay Arena in Sydney in July and August 2027, with Arlo Parks as special guest.
